initialization_each: Random model, empty replay, fresh output directory. No checkpoint or previous observations.
runtime: Recovered original learning/channel parameters and recovered 8x512 disagreement model; native two-creator/16-lane/prefetch4 asynchronous sampling; original current XLA flags; instrumentation disabled during training.
rationale: Three prospectively registered independent from-zero repeats use the ordinary recovered entrypoint without an imposed creator owner prefix or per-update trace observer. This checks whether the earlier startup-order control explains the shortfall while preserving the paper settings. Report every run, including failures.
completion_rule: Each trial completes50k; no early stopping and no performance-based omission.
acceptance: Each result independently compared with original18.837550, ±0.2bps/Hz and two-stage curve gate; source/action/physical audits required. A passing run is a candidate and needs fresh computational replay validation before claiming successful reproduction.
